jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Progressive Building Society is a leading local financial institution with a proud reputation for customer service excellence. Our purpose is to encourage local people to save and become homeowners, through our personal, caring & common-sense approach, essentially nurturing financial well being for current and future generations.

The Society is continuing to modernise and improve through its operational resilience processes, strong customer experience including self-services capabilities, integration between platforms, automation of processes, supporting our community and caring about our environmental impact.

**What you will be doing**

Developing, supporting and continuously improving software solutions that enhance the Society’s systems and business processes, working under supervision as part of the IT team and in line with Progressive’s development standards, security controls and regulatory requirements.

The role contributes to the Society’s strategic plan by analysing requirements, building and integrating applications, and promoting best practices such as CI/CD and test-driven development to improve user experience, automation and operational efficiency.

**About The Role**

**The Software Developer will be required to:**

* Analyse business needs with stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing projects.
* Work with the in-house subject matter experts and IT teams to support the business and improve automation of key processes.
* Develop and maintain .NET solutions (e.g., C#, ASP.NET Core, APIs and background services) or SaaS platform changes, in line with agreed architecture and the Society’s coding standards and to deliver improved customer experience.
* Implement best practices such as continuous integration, continuous delivery and test-driven development.
* Write and maintain automated tests (unit/integration) using appropriate .NET testing frameworks and support test execution within the CI pipeline.
* Use source control and follow branching, pull request and code review practices; address review feedback and share learning with the team.
* Support data-related development including SQL query writing, stored procedure changes where applicable, and safe use of ORM/data access patterns.
* Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of defects and incidents across development, test and production environments, under supervision, including root-cause analysis and fix validation.
* Produce clear technical documentation (e.g., configuration notes, support guides and release notes) to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* Support build and release processes for .NET applications (e.g., Azure DevOps pipelines), including deployment steps, environment configuration and post-release verification.
* Use AI-assisted development tools appropriately to support software design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge discovery, while applying professional judgement, security requirements and coding standards.
* Evaluate and validate outputs generated by AI tools to ensure accuracy, maintainability, security and compliance with the Society's policies and regulatory obligations.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging development practices, including responsible use of AI technologies to improve team productivity and software quality.

  *Progressive Building Society is committed to providing equal opportunities for all. As part of our recruitment process, successful applicants will be subject to our pre-employment checks. These include credit checks and criminal record checks (Access NI basic check through a responsible body).*

**Required Criteria**

* Degree in Computer Science related discipline.
* A minimum of one year’s experience developing applications in a professional work environment.
* Experience of .NET ecosystem and C#.
* Awareness of programming best practices and ability to apply them under guidance
* Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and their potential to deliver business benefits.
* Good analytical approach to problem solving.
* API integration to core platforms (e.g. banking systems).
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to adapt style and explanations to support others’ understanding.
* Understanding of AI-assisted software development tools and the ability to apply them effectively to support coding, testing, debugging, documentation and problem solving.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure solutions meet security, quality and business requirements.

**Desired Criteria**

* A scripting language, such as Python or Powershell.
* Development and design skills with MS SQL or Oracle.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or similar technologies.

**About The Company**

Careers at Progressive

We know that looking for a career means so much more than just finding a job. At Progressive, we want to help you find your happy place to work.

We firmly believe in encouraging our employees to achieve the right balance between their work and personal lives, delivering access to and promoting family-friendly policies.

This not only increases employee satisfaction but also enables Progressive to meet the needs of our Members and supports the Society in being positioned as one of the most successful financial institutions in Northern Ireland.

**Company Culture**

To work for Progressive is to be part of something special. We strive to nurture and develop our employees in the evolving and fast paced financial services industry. Outlined below are a list of the reasons why we feel Progressive is a great place to work:

We aim to provide an inclusive and respectful working environment, where everyone recognises the importance and impact of teamwork.

We celebrate staff diversity and work hard to ensure that our staff members feel valued as individuals and respected for their contribution to our success.

We offer opportunities for our staff to work at the heart of our communities and make real differences to our Members’ lives.

We do not subscribe to a long-hours culture, instead valuing family life and supporting our staff to balance work and family commitments.

**Company Benefits**

We offer our staff competitive employment conditions and a range of benefits designed to achieve high levels of staff engagement and job satisfaction.

We understand that by taking steps to positively enhance the well-being of our staff, we can help them to achieve their goals and boost their motivation to deliver the best possible outcomes for our members.

Vacation, Paid time off, Performance bonuses, Paid sick days, Retirement plan and/or pension, Employee development programs, Tuition reimbursement, Open office, Competitive salary, Life insurance, Long service recognition, Employee Assistance Scheme, Wellbeing Scheme, Work With Charities, Social Opportunities, Annual Rise

**Salary**

Not disclosed

jobs.title: AI & Software Development Apprentice
jobs.description:
**Hands-On AI & Software Development Apprentice**

**Full-time apprenticeship | Northampton | On site**

**Cybist has an exceptional opportunity for a bright, creative and ambitious aspiring software developer to take steps towards turning a passion for AI into a career, in a real world practical environment helping build intelligent applications and integrations that make a real difference to a growing business.**

**About Cybist**

We are a rapidly growing **eco tech business**, giving high-quality computers and IT equipment a second life, reducing electronic waste and making technology more accessible. Visit cybist.com or visit our Amazon webstore.

Our small, friendly, professional team has big ambitions. We are rapidly integrating AI into our software and business systems, developing tools for product identification, listing creation, app integration and commercial decision-making.

Our commitment to creating opportunities for young people has been recognised with a Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) Kickstart award. We are also engaging with Amazon’s US team on advanced listing and multichannel selling tools, contributing practical feedback from our own development and commercial experience.

You will learn how AI and software can support our work streams - and you will be hands-on and carry out work with the hardware itself, equipment and processes.

As your skills develop, the role can evolve around your strengths, interests and the needs of the business.

**What you will work on**

* Building and testing AI-assisted applications for real business use.
* Connecting apps and services through APIs and tools such as Zapier, Make and n8n.
* Developing software that supports product listings, ecommerce and our internal operational systems.
* Supporting practical production and stock workflows, using our mobile app to capture product information and photographs, and helping organise equipment in the correct stock areas.
* Working with code, databases and AI tools to solve practical problems.
* Exploring new ideas and helping turn the best ones into reliable, useful applications.

**Who we are looking for**

Someone with a fantastic enthusiasm for AI and software, strong technical curiosity and an ability to solve problems and the determination to work things out. Someone not afraid to work hard and to put in what it takes to achieve success.

You should already be experimenting with coding, AI tools or automation. Personal projects, college work, a useful script, an app integration or something you have built for fun can all demonstrate your potential.

Familiarity with coding would be useful, whether in Python, JavaScript or another language. We also value creativity, clear thinking, attention to detail and the ability to work well with others. Our current system being developed is PostgressSQL/.NET/React and Tailwind using ChatGPT Pro/Codex.

**What you will gain**

* Structured apprenticeship training, a recognised qualification and paid time for learning.
* Practical support and mentoring within a small team.
* Experience developing software and AI integrations used in a real business.
* The chance to contribute ideas and take increasing responsibility as your skills grow.
* A foundation for a career in software development, AI and automation.

**How to apply**

To help your application stand out, please send your CV with a short cover letter explaining:

* Why this opportunity interests you.
* Why you think you would be especially good at it, including examples of anything you have built or explored.
* When you would be available to come in, meet the team and attend an interview.

Links to projects, GitHub repositories, screenshots or a short demonstration are welcome. Tell us what you personally contributed and what you learned.

**If you have the curiosity to explore, the creativity to build and the ambition to keep improving, we would like to hear from you.**

Pay: £15,000.00-£18,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Free parking
* On-site parking

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: HVDC Converter Station Engineer
jobs.description:
Team

**Engineering**

Business Unit

**National Grid Ventures**

Requisition No.

**12158**

City

**Warwick, GB, CV34 6DA**

Date posted

**5 October 2026**

**HVDC Converter Station Engineer**
===================================

### **About the role**

Are you an ambitious electrical engineer looking to work on some of the most innovative energy infrastructure projects in Europe?

At **National Grid Ventures (NGV)**, we're delivering the next generation of interconnectors and offshore hybrid assets that will help connect renewable energy, strengthen energy security and support the transition to net zero. As an **HVDC Converter Station Engineer**, you'll play a key role in shaping the technology at the heart of these projects, including **LionLink** – a pioneering development connecting the UK to offshore wind generation in the Netherlands and onward to the Dutch onshore grid.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop specialist expertise in **High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC)** technology while working alongside industry-leading engineers, international partners and global technology suppliers.

### **What you'll do**

As a Converter Station Engineer, you'll support the design, development and delivery of HVDC converter station systems across major strategic projects. You'll gain exposure to real engineering challenges and play a key part in ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest technical standards.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development and assurance of converter station requirements from concept through to delivery.
* Providing technical support during the Development Consent Order (DCO) process, including the preparation of responses to technical queries.
* Working with OEMs, consultants and project partners to demonstrate compliance with GB Grid Code requirements, National Grid standards and project specifications.
* Reviewing designs, studies, reports and technical proposals, helping to resolve engineering challenges throughout project delivery.
* Supporting critical interfaces across converter technology, grid connection, cable, civil, control and wider project teams.
* Participating in design reviews, factory acceptance testing, site testing and commissioning activities.
* Supporting the integration of protection and control systems, communications, auxiliary systems and third-party interfaces.
* Contributing technical expertise to tender evaluations and future technology selections.

### **What you'll need**

We're looking for engineers who are curious, collaborative and excited by the opportunity to develop expertise in a specialist area that is central to the energy transition.

You'll ideally have:

* A degree, or equivalent experience, in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, HVDC, Control Systems, Substations or a related discipline.
* A genuine interest in power transmission, renewable energy integration or major infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of HVDC technology, converter stations, substations, electrical systems or protection and control systems (desirable but not essential).
* The ability to analyse technical information and communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to learning.
* A collaborative mindset and the confidence to contribute within a supportive engineering team.

### **What you'll get**

A competitive salary between £54,000 - £63,000 per annum– dependent on capability.

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

###

**This role closes on Tuesday 20th October at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.

Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

jobs.title: Systemutvecklare C#/.NET
jobs.description:
Vi söker en erfaren C#/.NET-utvecklare till ett utvecklingsuppdrag i en säkerhetskritisk offentlig verksamhet i Solna. Du blir en viktig del av ett team som utvecklar och förvaltar system i en säkerhetskritisk offentlig verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta nära verksamheten och bidra med stabila, långsiktiga lösningar i en miljö med höga krav på kvalitet och tillgänglighet. Om rollen Utveckla verksamhetskritiska system i en säkerhetskänslig miljö.
  
  
Arbeta i ett team med fokus på robusta och hållbara lösningar. Bidra genom hela utvecklingslivscykeln, från utveckling till förvaltning. Det här kommer du göra Utveckla backendnära funktionalitet i C# och .NET Core. Bygga och vidareutveckla integrationer mellan olika system.
  
  
Arbeta med databaser och lösningar kopplade till SQL Server. Medverka i testning, felsökning och kvalitetssäkring av mjukvara. Bidra till driftsättning och DevOps-arbete i on-prem-miljö. Vi söker dig som har Minst fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling i C# och .NET Core.
  
  
Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av systemintegrationer och SQL Server. Erfarenhet av testning samt förståelse för drift, tillgänglighet och infrastruktur. Möjlighet att arbeta i en säkerhetskritisk miljö med särskilda behörighetskrav.
  
  
Teknik & Verktyg C# .NET Core SQL Server Systemintegration DevOps i on-prem-miljö Praktisk information Ort: Solna Arbetssätt: Arbete på plats Språk: Flytande svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift

jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till Installatörsföretagen
jobs.description:
**Om oss:** Installatörsföretagen är en bransch- och arbetsgivarorganisation för svenska installationsföretag som driver klimatomställningen framåt genom elektrifiering, energieffektivisering och smarta installationer. Som en del av Svenskt Näringsliv arbetar vi på både nationell och regional nivå med opinion, kompetensförsörjning, kollektivavtal och affärsutveckling för våra medlemmars bästa. Vår roll är att vara en stark röst för branschen, stödja företagen i deras vardag och skapa förutsättningar för ett konkurrenskraftigt, hållbart och modernt samhälle. Här möts du av en kultur präglad av engagemang, frihet under ansvar och en inkluderande arbetsplats där olika bakgrunder och perspektiv är välkomna.
  
  
**Om rollen:** Som .NET-utvecklare hos Installatörsföretagen blir du en del av ett mindre, sammansvetsat team där ansvar, samarbete och utveckling står i centrum. Du får en nyckelroll i att bygga och vidareutveckla digitala lösningar som förenklar vardagen för våra 4 500 medlemsföretag och stärker hela installationsbranschen. I rollen arbetar du både med att förvalta och förbättra befintliga system samt med att utveckla nya, större initiativ med tydlig verksamhetspåverkan. Det du skapar används dagligen av tusentals företag i en bransch där kvalitet, säkerhet och tillförlitlighet är avgörande, och där ditt arbete gör verklig skillnad.
  
  
Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, målmedveten och serviceinriktad, samt att du har efterfrågade kompetenser och erfarenheter: Relevant akademisk utbildning inom IT/systemutveckling. Minst 5 års erfarenhet som systemutvecklare med .NET/C#. God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med kollegor på daglig basis. Erfarenhet av mikrotjänster, API-design, databasutveckling och Azure.
  
  
Erfarenhet av DevOps, CI/CD, och arbete med distribuerade system. Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet och regelverk inom IT. Hos oss får du: · En flexibel arbetsvardag med möjlighet att kombinera arbete på kontoret med distansarbete. · En arbetsplats med närhet till kommunikationer, ett rikt utbud av lunchrestauranger samt olika gym och joggingstråk.
  
  
Redo att ta nästa steg och bli Installatörsföretagens nya .NET-utvecklare? Ansök idag och var med och forma framtidens installationsbransch. Har du frågor om rollen eller vår rekryteringsprocess, vänligen kontakta Selma Kauppi på selma.kauppi@ants.se
